faq_list.q1: How long does the treatment journey in Egypt take?
faq_list.a1: The duration varies depending on the type of treatment, but most Saudi clients complete their treatment within 5-7 days. We provide a detailed treatment plan specifying the exact duration before your travel.
faq_list.q2: Is there assistance with visa and accommodation?
faq_list.a2: We provide assistance with visa procedures (if needed) and recommend suitable hotels in locations close to the clinic. We can also arrange airport-to-clinic transfer services.
faq_list.q3: Can I communicate with the clinic team before traveling?
faq_list.a3: Yes, we offer a free initial video consultation to discuss your condition and needs before traveling, to ensure your treatment journey to Egypt is beneficial and effective.
faq_list.q4: Is there follow-up after returning to Saudi Arabia?
faq_list.a4: Yes, we provide free remote follow-ups after your return to Saudi Arabia, to ensure the stability of results and offer the necessary advice.
faq_list.a5: No, all team members speak Arabic fluently, and many of them speak the Saudi dialect, making communication and understanding your needs easy.
